title: Audio generation arrives through the text API
summary:
A text API day that quietly became an audio API too, with streaming sound and sturdier tools for chat agents.

text.pollinations.ai gained audio model support and PCM16 streaming output, with follow-up fixes to make the stream usable in practice. Send text, receive audio; software remains determined to make every interface eventually produce sound.

The API documentation now covers audio generation, and the README's audio-model link leads there instead of making builders forage through the repository.

Function-calling tool parameters were fixed, while search-tool handling received a round of improvements and follow-up repairs. Agents can spend a little less time arguing with their own tool schema.
